issues.issue: Whether the claimant is excluded under Article 1F(b) for serious non-political crimes before entering Canada
issues.applicant_position: Crimes were committed under age 12 with no home or food, so they are not serious crimes; mitigating circumstances apply.
issues.respondent_position: Minister sought exclusion for repeated breaking and entering; the text gives no further argument.
issues.result_quote: I find the claimant is not excluded pursuant to section 1(F)(b).

issues.issue: Whether fear of a poor life, general crime and family matters gives protection under s. 96 or 97
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears a bad life and general crime in Honduras and wants to work in Canada.
issues.result_quote: Crime, a fear of crime, is not a Convention ground unless crime is tied to a Convention ground, and none has been alleged in this case.

issues.issue: Whether Tegucigalpa is a viable internal flight alternative
issues.applicant_position: Fears the powerful XXXXX family in his home city; the text does not show he argued against the capital.
issues.result_quote: I find that Tegucigalpa is an appropriate internal flight alternative.
